According to Benzinga, the market had originally forecast about an 80,000 increase in July jobs, but weak hiring in the government sector caused nonfarm payrolls to decline by 53,000. Private firms still added 30,000 jobs, far below the market’s expectation of 78,000.

The unemployment rate fell from 4.2% to 4.1%, but this is not a sign of a strong economy. The labor force shrank by 264,000 and the labor‑participation rate slipped to 61.4%, a low not seen since early 2021.

Even more noteworthy is the large downward revision of prior figures: May and June combined were revised down by 103,000 jobs, making the employment trend over the past three months considerably weaker than the market had originally believed.
On wages, the hourly earnings growth rate slowed to 3.2% year‑over‑year, the slowest pace since 2021.

How to buy a party out of bad news? Analysts note that the weaker jobs data removed the rationale for a Fed rate hike. Using CME’s FedWatch tool, the probability of a September hike dropped sharply from 58% to 42%.

The dip in rate expectations pulled U.S. Treasury yields and the dollar lower, providing the most reliable catalyst for gains in long‑term tech stocks and gold. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY‑US) jumped 3.5% for the week, its best weekly performance since mid‑April.
At the same time, the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 (QQQ‑US), which tracks the Nasdaq‑100, surged 4.8% for the week, its strongest showing since early May.
Gold rallied 2.4% on Friday (the 7th), reaching a seven‑week high of $4,347.70 per ounce, up about 7.5% for the week and marking its best week in seven months.
Stock performance was polarized. The standout performer was photonics component maker Coherent (COHR‑US), which surged 43.5% over five trading days.

The company makes optical transmission components that connect AI chips, benefitting from peers’ earnings, news that the U.S. may tighten export limits on Chinese optical transceivers, and JPMorgan raising its target price from $380 to $435, prompting renewed market interest. Coherent will release its earnings next Wednesday (the 12th).

Software firm Palantir (PLTR‑US) delivered the most impressive earnings this week. Q2 revenue jumped 93% year‑over‑year to $1.94 billion, with U.S. commercial revenue soaring 149%, and full‑year revenue guidance was lifted to $8.15 billion.
CEO Alex Karp called the results “extraordinary,” and Palantir’s stock surged nearly 29% on Tuesday (the 4th), one of the best single‑day performances in the company’s history.

Barcode and warehouse‑automation company Zebra Technologies (ZBRA‑US) was a surprise dark horse, reporting adjusted earnings of $6.35 per share, well above the $4.36 consensus – a 45% beat – and revenue grew 20.4% to $1.56 billion, prompting an annual outlook upgrade to a $20.75‑$21.25 range.

In contrast, companies with weak guidance were hammered. Advertising‑tech firm The Trade Desk (TTD‑US) saw its market value evaporate by about a quarter; despite revenue growing 3% to $715.1 million, its Q3 revenue outlook of roughly $650 million fell far short of the $805 million consensus, and the firm announced the replacement of its CFO, CMO and CRO.
Honeywell Aerospace (HONA‑US), which spun out of Honeywell and listed in June, cut its full‑year organic revenue growth outlook from 7‑9% to 4‑5% in its first earnings release.

Dialysis provider DaVita (DVA‑US) posted earnings that beat expectations, yet its stock plunged 17% because the company left its guidance unchanged – and the midpoint of that guidance was already below market consensus.

The focus now shifts to next week’s CPI. Analysts say the market’s attention is on the July CPI to be released on August 12. Economists expect overall inflation to ease from 3.5% to 3.4%, with core inflation (excluding food and energy) slowing from 2.6% to 2.5%.

If the data come in mild, expectations for a September rate hike could cool further; if inflation surprises on the high side, rate‑hike concerns may resurface, potentially pulling back the gold, small‑cap and long‑duration tech stocks that led the market this week.

On the other hand, Applied Materials (AMAT‑US), touted as one of the best‑performing semiconductor stocks of 2026, will report earnings after the U.S. market close on Thursday (the 13th), and investors will be watching closely.
Analysts conclude that weak employment data gave Wall Street a celebratory rally this time, but next week’s CPI will be the key determinant of whether the party can continue.

items.title: 川普頻喊和平市場買單嗎？荷姆茲海峽協議陷空談 專家示警油價恐暴漲
items.title_en: Is Trump's Call for Peace in the Market Being Bought? Hormuz Strait Agreement Stalls, Experts Warn of Potential Oil Price Surge
paras: 川普政府本周釋放美國與伊朗可能很快就荷姆茲海峽達成協議的樂觀訊號，帶動油價下跌、股市大漲，但最終協議並未出現。這一切似曾相識：美國總統川普已數十次宣稱，美伊即將達成協議，結束這場已持續超過五個月的戰爭。為何市場多次買單？
RBC Capital Markets 全球大宗商品策略主管 Helima Croft 說：「市場存在極大的樂觀偏誤。」
市場持續假設，對美國與伊朗而言，外交途徑都符合雙方利益。Croft 指出，一些投資人似乎「把協議視為一台時光機」，認為協議一旦達成，就能讓中東恢復到戰前狀態，但這種情況不太可能發生。
近期衝突焦點集中在荷姆茲海峽，伊朗實質上封鎖了這條海峽的能力，引發全球能源供應衝擊，推升汽油價格、加劇通膨，也引發市場對石油儲備的警戒。
白宮發言人 Anna Kelly 說：「總統始終偏好外交途徑，但他保留所有選項，以確保伊朗永遠無法擁有核武。」
即使認為外交仍是實現和平的可行途徑，相關人士也承認，荷姆茲海峽的未來仍是難以解決的問題。
Rystad Energy 合夥人暨首席經濟學家 Claudio Galimberti 說：「荷姆茲海峽的命運似乎仍存在根本分歧：伊朗希望收取服務費，美國則希望恢復戰前狀況，也就是讓荷姆茲海峽維持國際性自由水域。」

貝森特、川普釋放協議即將達成訊號

油市渴望看到任何有關荷姆茲海峽重新開放進展的訊號。美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 周二大力釋放樂觀訊號，表示確保海峽「自由通行」的協議，可能在數小時內達成。
他當天說：「我們正在與伊朗人談判。有可能今天或明天就達成協議，重新開放海峽，並讓這場衝突朝更正常化的方向發展。」
貝森特談話後，油價重挫、股市大漲、公債殖利率回落，當時投資人的樂觀情緒與人工智慧 (AI) 帶動的科技股行情相互呼應。
然而，原油價格仍遠高於戰前水準，交易員持續在「荷姆茲海峽可能出現持久解決方案」的希望，以及美國可能升高軍事行動的擔憂之間反覆擺盪。
Rapidan Energy Group 總裁 Bob McNally 認為，市場「仍陷在劇烈波動的摸索式過渡狀態」，「雖然伊朗與阿曼可能就荷姆茲海峽管理方案達成有限協議，但我們看不到美伊之間能讓荷姆茲海峽恢復正常、也是原油市場希望看到的更廣泛且持久的協議。」
儘管如此，貝森特的談話仍進一步提振原本已經轉趨樂觀的市場預期。川普早在上周日晚間宣布取消對伊朗的大規模攻擊，理由是「已達成協議框架」。
這項說法與川普過去多次威脅要徹底摧毀伊朗、最後卻退回談判桌的情況如出一轍，也在周一推升股市，當天道瓊工業指數收盤創歷史新高。
川普周二晚間再度加碼，表示重新開放荷姆茲海峽的協議「可能」最快周三或周四達成，因為「已取得很多進展」。
儘管川普延長了貝森特提出的協議時間表，他的談話仍持續推升投資人預期。道瓊周三收盤再創新高，油價則維持穩定。

伊朗反駁川普說法

美股快速上漲之際，伊朗則是一再強調，目前並未積極與美國進行談判。
伊朗表示，正與另一個波斯灣區域大國阿曼談判，希望自行就通過荷姆茲海峽的航運問題達成協議。
川普則憤怒反駁，堅稱美伊談判正在進行，並批評伊朗否認談判的說法是「兩面手法」。他也持續聲稱，美國已完全控制荷姆茲海峽，但實際情況是目前船舶通行量仍遠低於戰前平均水準，當時全球約 20% 的石油會經由這條水道運輸。
伊朗國營媒體則在周四報導一項荷姆茲海峽協議草案，內容包括禁止美國與以色列船隻通行，以及實施其他限制。市場原本對即將達成協議的期待暫時破滅。
川普政府很快就將伊朗媒體報導的草案，視為無法接受的方案。一名美國官員表示：「任何臨時航線都不會有任何阻礙，也就是不需要批准或許可，也不會收取通行費或其他費用。荷姆茲海峽是國際水道，任何一方都無法控制航道或通行權。」
川普周四下午被問到是否已與伊朗達成重新開放荷姆茲海峽的協議時，他回答：「我不想說已經達成。現在算是開放的。」
他接著說：「我認為我們做得非常好。我參與談判。我認為進展很好…… 可能很快就會有結果。」
自戰爭爆發以來，伊朗始終對美國採取強硬挑釁姿態，多次嘲諷川普。伊朗國會議長卡利巴夫 (Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf) 周四下午在 X 平台發文嘲諷：「『大規模攻擊即將到來…… 等等，他們想談判了。』這就是循環上演的戲劇式外交。」
卡利巴夫寫道：「利用霸凌、違背承諾與假新聞作為籌碼，是一項失敗的策略。」

「根深蒂固的樂觀偏誤」

隨著戰爭進入第六個月，據傳美國的石油庫存與關鍵彈藥庫存都正在減少，分析師開始質疑，市場還能因協議即將達成的希望保持樂觀多久。
RBC 在 7 月 28 日的策略報告中指出，「受頭條新聞帶動的價格回落循環，可能讓市場相信衝突造成的經濟成本仍可控」，但美國戰略石油儲備 (SPR) 持續下降，則顯示「全球緩衝能力正在減弱」。
Rapidan 的 McNally 警告，如果雙方無法控制軍事升級，或持續消耗庫存使市場「根深蒂固的樂觀偏誤」消退，油價可能重新飆回高點，迫使市場透過降低消費來抑制價格。
Rystad 的 Galimberti 說：「我的直覺是，如果他們希望避免代價高昂的僵局，避免油價迅速升回 4 月水準甚至更高、同時伊朗石油供應幾乎完全中斷，那麼雙方就必須開始彌合分歧，讓各自的紅線向中間靠攏。」
paras_en: The Trump administration released an optimistic signal this week that the US and Iran may soon reach an agreement on the Hormuz Strait, leading to a drop in oil prices and a surge in the stock market. However, the agreement did not materialize. This is not the first time: US President Trump has claimed dozens of times that the US and Iran are about to reach an agreement to end the war that has lasted for over five months. Why does the market buy into it every time?
Helima Croft, global head of commodity strategy at RBC Capital Markets, said: 'There is a huge optimistic bias in the market.'

The market continues to assume that a diplomatic approach is in the best interest of both the US and Iran. Croft pointed out that some investors seem to view an agreement as a 'time machine' that can restore the Middle East to its pre-war state, but this is unlikely to happen.

Recently, the focus of the conflict has been on the Hormuz Strait, where Iran's ability to block the strait has led to a global energy supply shock, pushing up gasoline prices and inflation, and triggering market warnings about oil reserves.
White House spokesperson Anna Kelly said: 'The President has always preferred a diplomatic approach, but he reserves all options to ensure that Iran never possesses nuclear weapons.'
Even if diplomacy is still seen as a viable path to peace, those involved acknowledge that the future of the Hormuz Strait remains a difficult issue to resolve.

Claudio Galimberti, partner and chief economist at Rystad Energy, said: 'The fate of the Hormuz Strait seems to be a fundamental point of disagreement: Iran wants to charge a service fee, while the US wants to restore the pre-war status quo, making the Hormuz Strait an international waterway.'

Bessent and Trump released signals that an agreement was about to be reached. The oil market is eager to see any sign of progress on the reopening of the Hormuz Strait. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent strongly released an optimistic signal on Tuesday, saying that an agreement to ensure the 'free passage' of the strait could be reached within hours.
He said: 'We are negotiating with the Iranians. It is possible that we will reach an agreement today or tomorrow to reopen the strait and move the conflict in a more normalized direction.'
After Bessent's remarks, oil prices plummeted, the stock market surged, and bond yields fell, as investors' optimism and the AI-driven tech stock rally coincided.
However, crude oil prices remain far above pre-war levels, and traders continue to oscillate between hopes for a lasting solution to the Hormuz Strait and concerns about potential US military action.

Bob McNally, president of Rapidan Energy Group, believes that the market is 'still in a state of intense volatility and searching for a transition.' 'Although Iran and Oman may reach a limited agreement on the management of the Hormuz Strait, we do not see a broader and more lasting agreement between the US and Iran that would restore the Hormuz Strait to normal and satisfy the oil market.'

Despite this, Bessent's remarks further boosted market expectations, which had already turned optimistic. Trump announced on Sunday night that he had canceled a large-scale attack on Iran, citing 'a framework for an agreement.'

This claim is similar to Trump's previous threats to thoroughly destroy Iran, only to return to the negotiating table, which also boosted the stock market on Monday, with the Dow Jones closing at a record high.
Trump added on Tuesday night that an agreement to reopen the Hormuz Strait 'may' be reached as early as Wednesday or Thursday, as 'a lot of progress' had been made.

Although Trump extended the timeline for an agreement proposed by Bessent, his remarks continued to boost investor expectations. The Dow Jones closed at a new high on Wednesday, while oil prices remained stable.
Iran countered Trump's claims, emphasizing that it was not actively negotiating with the US.
Iran stated that it was negotiating with another major country in the Persian Gulf region, Oman, in an effort to reach an agreement on shipping through the Hormuz Strait on its own.

Trump angrily countered, insisting that US-Iran talks were underway and criticizing Iran's denial of negotiations as 'double-faced.' He also continued to claim that the US had complete control over the Hormuz Strait, although the current shipping volume is still far below the pre-war average, when about 20% of the world's oil was transported through the waterway.

Iranian state media reported on a draft agreement for the Hormuz Strait on Thursday, which included a ban on US and Israeli ships and the implementation of other restrictions. Market expectations for an imminent agreement were temporarily dashed.

The Trump administration quickly deemed the draft agreement reported by Iranian media as unacceptable. A US official said: 'Any temporary route will have no obstacles, no need for approval or permission, and no tolls or other fees. The Hormuz Strait is an international waterway, and no party can control the channel or the right of passage.'
When asked on Thursday afternoon if he had reached an agreement with Iran to reopen the Hormuz Strait, Trump replied: 'I don't want to say that it's been reached. It's open now.'
He added: 'I think we're doing very well. I'm involved in the negotiations. I think we're making good progress... We may have a result soon.'

Since the outbreak of the war, Iran has consistently taken a tough and provocative stance against the US, mocking Trump on several occasions. Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf tweeted on Thursday afternoon: 'A large-scale attack is coming... Wait, they want to negotiate now.' This is the drama of diplomatic negotiations.
Ghalibaf wrote: 'Using bullying, breaking promises, and fake news as a strategy is a failed approach.'

As the war enters its sixth month, with US oil and critical ammunition stocks reportedly declining, analysts are beginning to question how long the market can remain optimistic about the prospect of an agreement.

In a strategy report on July 28, RBC pointed out that 'the price drop cycle driven by headlines may lead the market to believe that the economic cost of the conflict is still controllable,' but the continued decline in US strategic petroleum reserves (SPR) shows that 'global buffer capacity is weakening.'

Rapidan's McNally warned that if the two sides fail to control military escalation or continue to consume stocks, the market's 'deep-seated optimistic bias' may dissipate, causing oil prices to surge again and forcing the market to reduce consumption to curb prices.

Rystad's Galimberti said: 'My intuition is that if they want to avoid a costly stalemate, avoid oil prices quickly rising back to April levels or even higher, and almost completely cut off Iranian oil supplies, then they need to start bridging their differences and moving their red lines towards the middle.'

items.title: 輝達Rubin Ultra傳縮減HBM容量！記憶體短缺下晶片廠商如何破局？
items.title_en: NVIDIA's Rubin Ultra GPU May See Reduced HBM Capacity Amid Memory Shortages
paras: AI 晶片巨頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 傳出正悄悄調整下一代旗艦晶片的設計藍圖。據了解，該公司近期針對新一代 Rubin Ultra GPU 測試多款「縮水版」配置，部分方案的高頻寬記憶體（HBM）容量已不如當初規劃，凸顯這波 AI 熱潮帶動的晶片需求，正反過來讓晶片大廠自己也陷入記憶體不夠用的窘境。
知情人士透露，過去數週輝達已測試至少三種 HBM 規格經過下修的 Rubin Ultra 版本。回顧去年輝達年度開發者大會，執行長黃仁勳親自揭曉 Rubin Ultra 時曾誇下海口，強調每顆晶片將搭載高達 1TB 的 HBM4e 記憶體，透過 16 組堆疊架構打造前所未有的運算效能。
不過，市場調查機構 TrendForce 指出，輝達近期已跳脫原先規劃的 12 層 HBM4e 單一路線，另外拉出 8 層 HBM4e、12 層 HBM4、8 層 HBM4 等三套備案同步評估，目前尚未定案最終規格會落在哪個版本。
TrendForce 分析，這波規格重新評估背後有兩大推手。首先，市場普遍預期 2027 年整體 DRAM 產業將面臨供給緊張，屆時可投入 HBM 生產的晶圓產能勢必被壓縮；其次，12 層 HBM4e 目前仍在測試驗證階段，未來量產後的良率能否達標，仍是一大未知數。
除了 HBM 之外，記憶體吃緊的警訊也蔓延到其他產品線。TrendForce 透露，由於 LPDDR5X 晶片缺貨狀況預料將延燒至 2027 年，輝達已拍板將 Vera Rubin 超級晶片模組所搭載的 SOCAMM 記憶體模組容量直接砍半。
業界人士點出這起事件最諷刺之處：正是輝達自家 AI 晶片賣得太好，才把整個產業的記憶體需求推向高峰、加劇供應吃緊，如今這股缺貨壓力竟回頭反噬輝達本身，使公司不得不修改記憶體配置因應。
記憶體荒的效應並非輝達獨自面對。TrendForce 指出，包括多家大型雲端服務業者在內，也正評估將旗下自研 AI 專用晶片的 HBM 容量向下調整。
該機構同時預估，儘管 2027 年全球 HBM 出貨總位元數可望較前一年成長 50% 至 60%，但即便如此仍難以填補市場的實際需求缺口。
在供不應求的格局下，TrendForce 研判，HBM 供應商在 2027 年全年將持續握有定價主導權，反觀下游的 AI 晶片廠商，勢必得同時承受「拿不到貨」與「成本墊高」的雙重夾擊。

省下的記憶體錢 轉戰光互聯技術

記憶體降規對終端用戶而言並非全無影響。分析認為，記憶體容量縮水恐波及晶片實際運算效能，若企業採用這些降規版本來訓練或運行大型 AI 模型，恐怕得比原先計畫添購更多顆 GPU，才能補足效能缺口。
半導體研究機構 SemiAnalysis 分析指出，輝達從 HBM 記憶體上省下來的成本，很可能轉而挹注到交換器與光互聯元件等領域，透過分層式儲存架構搭配光互聯技術，設法緩解 HBM 價格居高不下、供貨緊繃帶來的衝擊。
這樣的策略也呼應了黃仁勳先前的公開說法，供應鏈一旦卡關，雖然會讓上游供應商坐擁議價優勢，但同時也會逼著企業端拿出創新技術方案，設法突圍。
儘管輝達可望藉由拉高 GPU 運算能力、優化互聯頻寬等方式，部分彌補記憶體降規帶來的效能損失，但業界普遍認為，整體系統建置成本與叢集架設的複雜程度恐怕只會有增無減。
對微軟 (MSFT-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 、Google(GOOGL-US) 等持續砸重金加碼 AI 基礎建設的雲端巨頭而言，這也代表未來資料中心的興建成本，恐怕還有進一步上修的空間。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) is reportedly adjusting the design plans for its next-generation flagship GPU, Rubin Ultra. According to sources, the company has been testing multiple "downsized" configurations for the new GPU, with some versions featuring reduced high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity.

Insiders claim that NVIDIA has been testing at least three versions of Rubin Ultra with reduced HBM specifications over the past few weeks. Last year, CEO Jensen Huang showcased Rubin Ultra at the NVIDIA Developer Conference, touting its 1TB HBM4e memory capacity, which would be achieved through a 16-stack architecture.

However, market research firm TrendForce notes that NVIDIA has shifted away from its original 12-layer HBM4e single-line plan and is now evaluating three alternative configurations: 8-layer HBM4, 12-layer HBM4, and 8-layer HBM4.

TrendForce analysts suggest that the shift in HBM specifications is driven by two factors. Firstly, the market expects a global DRAM shortage in 2027, which will reduce the available HBM production capacity. Secondly, the 12-layer HBM4e is still in the testing phase, and its yield rate is uncertain.

The memory shortage is not limited to HBM. TrendForce reveals that NVIDIA is also reducing the memory capacity of its Vera Rubin superchip module's SOCAMM memory module by 50% due to LPDDR5X shortages expected to last until 2027.
Industry insiders point out the irony of the situation: NVIDIA's success in the AI chip market has driven up demand for memory, exacerbating the shortage, which is now affecting NVIDIA itself.
The memory shortage is not unique to NVIDIA. TrendForce notes that other cloud service providers are also evaluating reducing the HBM capacity of their custom AI chips.
The firm estimates that, despite a 50-60% increase in global HBM shipments in 2027, the market will still face a significant demand shortfall.
In a supply-constrained market, TrendForce predicts that HBM suppliers will maintain pricing power in 2027, while AI chip manufacturers will face "no supply" and "cost increases" simultaneously.

The reduced memory capacity may have implications for end-users. Analysts suggest that the reduced capacity could impact the actual computing performance of the GPU, potentially requiring more GPUs to be purchased to compensate for the performance gap.

Semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis suggests that NVIDIA may redirect the cost savings from HBM to other areas, such as interconnects and optical interconnects, to alleviate the impact of HBM price increases and supply constraints.

This strategy aligns with Jensen Huang's previous statements that supply chain disruptions will drive innovation in the industry. Companies will need to develop new technologies to overcome supply chain challenges.

While NVIDIA may be able to partially offset the performance loss from reduced memory capacity through increased GPU performance and optimized interconnects, the overall system build cost and complexity are likely to increase.

For cloud giants like Microsoft (MSFT-US), Meta (META-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), and Google (GOOGL-US), which are heavily investing in AI infrastructure, this may mean higher data center construction costs in the future.

items.title: 「SaaS末日」來了嗎？AI浪潮下軟體股表現兩極：誰獲勝、誰失敗一次看
items.title_en: Is the "SaaS Apocalypse" Here? Software Stocks Split in the AI Wave: Who Wins and Who Loses at a Glance
paras: 美股軟體類股本週財報季再度上演「幾家歡樂幾家愁」戲碼，市場對於人工智慧（AI）究竟會吃掉傳統軟體即服務（SaaS）業者的生意，還是反過來成為這些公司的成長引擎，看法愈趨分歧。
根據《Business Insider》報導，這波被外界稱為「SaaS 末日論」的疑慮，並未一視同仁地打擊所有軟體股，反而讓市場更精細地篩選出贏家與輸家，而週五（7 日）美股交易正好凸顯了這種分化。
企業協作工具商 Atlassian (TEAM-US) 、雲端通訊業者 Twilio(TWLO-US) 與客服中心軟體商 Five9 公布優於預期的財報後，週五收盤股價分別大漲 35.31%、24.89% 與 19.81%。
相較之下，行銷與客服軟體公司 HubSpot(HUBS-US) 週五收盤只上漲 3.96%。
分析人士指出，「AI 取代 SaaS」的敘事今年以來曾多次衝擊上述幾家公司股價，但隨著時間，市場逐漸看出更細膩的圖像：部分軟體公司握有較深的護城河，難以被輕易取代。
此外，許多業者也積極將 AI 功能整合進既有產品線，反而創造新的營收動能；至於個別公司股價的漲跌，往往還摻雜了各自獨特的營運變數。

Atlassian：執行長加碼買股 展現信心

旗下擁有 Jira、Confluence 等企業工作管理工具的 Atlassian，在財報大幅超越華爾街預期後，週五收盤大漲 35.31%。
公司第四季營收年增 28%，達 17.7 億美元，優於分析師預估的 16.6 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 1.87 美元，同樣勝過市場預期的 1.50 美元。
雲端業務營收則成長 31% 至 12 億美元。公司指出，雲端採用持續強勁，以及 AI 驅動的產品需求，是支撐未來展望的主要動能。
執行長 Mike Cannon-Brookes 向投資人表示，他計畫買進 2.5 億美元的 Atlassian 股票，以實際行動展現信心，認為公司有能力挺過「SaaS 末日」。

Twilio：AI 語音與訊息需求助攻 自由現金流創新高

雲端通訊平台公司 Twilio，週五收盤大漲 24.89%。
公司公布第二季營收 15 億美元，年增 22%，優於分析師預估的 14.3 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 1.47 美元，同樣超越市場預期的 1.32 美元。
值得注意的是，Twilio 單季自由現金流達 3.53 億美元，創下歷史新高。
公司對第三季營收的預測區間中值為 15.1 億美元，高於華爾街約 14.7 億美元的預估。管理層表示，AI 語音與訊息服務需求暢旺，帶動有機成長率加速至 17%。

Five9：AI 營收暴增 78% 但獲利能力承壓

雲端客服中心軟體商 Five9 財報表現溫和優於預期，週五收盤上漲 19.81%。不過，在盤前交易，Five9 股價僅小幅上漲約 1.7%。
公司第二季營收年增 10% 至 3.124 億美元，超越市場預估的 3.066 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 70 美分，也比市場預期高出約 2 美分。
細看財報內容，Five9 訂閱業務營收成長 14%，AI 相關營收更是暴增 78%，展現轉型動能。
不過，公司獲利能力出現隱憂，調整後毛利率從去年同期的 63% 收斂至 61.4%，調整後每股盈餘也較去年同期的 76 美分下滑至 70 美分。

HubSpot：財測不如預期 銷售週期拉長

以行銷、銷售與客戶服務軟體聞名的 HubSpo 週五收盤小幅上漲 3.96%，但仍難以挽回週四（6 日）暴跌 19% 的頹勢。
公司第二季營收年增 20% 至 9.117 億美元，優於市場預估的 8.983 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 3.26 美元，同樣勝過分析師預期的 3.02 美元。
然而，HubSpot 對第三季營收的財測低於華爾街預期。公司預估第三季營收將介於 9.24 億至 9.25 億美元，低於分析師約 9.41 億美元的預期，同時將全年營收財測中值下調了 2,200 萬美元。
執行長 Yamini Rangan 在財報電話會議上表示，定價與產品調整拉長了客戶的採購流程，而客戶預算趨於緊縮，也導致銷售週期延長。
財務長 Kate Bueker 表示，HubSpot 第二季新增 7,000 名客戶，低於公司原先預期的 9,000 至 1 萬名。
paras_en: U.S. software stocks again staged a "some celebrate, some worry" drama this week’s earnings season, as the market’s view diverges on whether artificial intelligence (AI) will eat away the business of traditional software‑as‑a‑service (SaaS) firms or become a growth engine for them.

According to Business Insider, the concern dubbed the "SaaS apocalypse" has not hit all software stocks uniformly; instead it has prompted the market to sift more finely for winners and losers, and Friday’s (the 7th) U.S. trading highlighted that split.

Enterprise collaboration tool maker Atlassian (TEAM‑US), cloud communications provider Twilio (TWLO‑US) and contact‑center software vendor Five9 all posted earnings that beat expectations, sending their shares up 35.31%, 24.89% and 19.81% respectively at Friday’s close.
By contrast, marketing and customer‑service software company HubSpot (HUBS‑US) rose only 3.96% at Friday’s close.

Analysts note that the narrative of "AI replacing SaaS" has knocked the stocks of the companies above several times this year, but over time the market is seeing a more nuanced picture: some software firms have deeper moats that are hard to erode.

Moreover, many players are actively embedding AI features into existing product lines, creating new revenue momentum; the price moves of individual stocks often also reflect each company’s unique operational variables.

Atlassian: CEO Increases Share Purchases to Show Confidence
Atlassian, which owns enterprise work‑management tools such as Jira and Confluence, saw its stock jump 35.31% after its earnings far exceeded Wall Street forecasts.
The company’s fourth‑quarter revenue grew 28% year‑over‑year to $1.77 billion, beating analysts’ estimate of $1.66 billion; adjusted earnings per share were $1.87, also ahead of the $1.50 consensus.
Cloud‑services revenue rose 31% to $1.2 billion. The firm said strong cloud adoption and AI‑driven product demand are the main drivers of its outlook.
CEO Mike Cannon‑Brookes told investors he plans to buy $250 million of Atlassian stock, using actual purchases to demonstrate confidence that the company can survive a "SaaS apocalypse."

Twilio: AI Voice and Messaging Demand Fuels Gains, Free Cash Flow Hits Record High
Cloud communications platform Twilio surged 24.89% at Friday’s close.
The company reported second‑quarter revenue of $1.5 billion, up 22% year‑over‑year and ahead of the $1.43 billion analysts expected; adjusted EPS was $1.47, also above the $1.32 forecast.
Notably, Twilio’s free cash flow for the quarter reached $353 million, a historic high.

For the third quarter, Twilio projects revenue around $1.51 billion, above Wall Street’s roughly $1.47 billion estimate. Management said strong demand for AI‑driven voice and messaging services is accelerating organic growth to 17%.

Five9: AI Revenue Soars 78% but Profitability Under Pressure
Contact‑center software provider Five9 posted modestly better‑than‑expected earnings, with its stock up 19.81% at Friday’s close. In pre‑market trading, the stock was up only about 1.7%.
Second‑quarter revenue grew 10% year‑over‑year to $312.4 million, topping the market’s $306.6 million estimate; adjusted EPS was $0.70, roughly $0.02 above expectations.
A deeper look shows Five9’s subscription revenue grew 14% while AI‑related revenue exploded 78%, highlighting transformation momentum.
However, profitability showed signs of strain, with adjusted gross margin narrowing from 63% a year ago to 61.4%, and adjusted EPS falling from $0.76 to $0.70 year‑over‑year.

HubSpot: Outlook Misses Expectations, Sales Cycle Lengthens
HubSpot, known for marketing, sales and customer‑service software, rose only 3.96% at Friday’s close, still unable to recover from a 19% plunge on Thursday (the 6th).
Second‑quarter revenue rose 20% year‑over‑year to $911.7 million, beating the $898.3 million consensus; adjusted EPS was $3.26, also above the $3.02 forecast.

Nevertheless, HubSpot’s third‑quarter revenue guidance fell short of Wall Street’s expectations. The company forecast Q3 revenue between $924 million and $925 million, below analysts’ roughly $941 million estimate, and trimmed the midpoint of its full‑year revenue outlook by $22 million.
CEO Yamini Rangan said in the earnings call that pricing and product adjustments have lengthened customers’ purchasing cycles, and tighter budgets have also extended the sales cycle.
CFO Kate Bueker noted that HubSpot added 7,000 new customers in Q2, below the company’s original expectation of 9,000 to 10,000.

items.title: 蘋果正式牽手阿里！Apple Intelligence整合「千問」　Siri可直接調用
items.title_en: Apple Partners with Alibaba: Apple Intelligence Integrates 'Qwen' Model, Siri Can Directly Call
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 與阿里巴巴 (09988-HK) 的人工智慧（AI）合作，如今已不再只是傳聞或監管文件上的字眼，而是實際寫進了蘋果官方的產品說明之中。
近日有網友發現，蘋果中國官網的《Mac 使用手冊》新增一個頁面，標題直白寫著「在 Mac 上配合蘋果智慧使用通義千問」。
這代表，阿里的大型語言模型「千問」已正式成為中國版 Apple Intelligence 系統中不可或缺的一環。
根據蘋果的說明，千問並非以獨立應用程式的形式出現在使用者眼前，而是深度嵌入 Apple Intelligence 的核心功能。
舉例來說，當 Siri 無法完整回答某些較複雜的提問時，系統會在背後呼叫千問來補強回覆內容，包括對照片與文件進行深入分析；在蘋果的寫作工具中，使用者同樣可以透過千問，依文字描述生成文字或圖像內容。
換句話說，多數使用者可能根本不需要主動開啟千問 App，只要在日常使用 Siri 提問、分析文件或啟動 AI 寫作功能時，就有機會在不知不覺間用上這套中國本土模型的運算能力。
事實上，蘋果與阿里的合作早有跡象可循。今年七月，《路透》報導指出，Apple Intelligence 相關的生成式 AI 服務已完成中國監管部門的備案程序；為符合中國市場法規要求，蘋果選擇同時與阿里巴巴、百度 (BIDU-US) 合作，其中阿里的千問模型將被整合進 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 與 visionOS 等多個系統平台。
《華爾街日報》稍早也曾報導，蘋果自 2025 年初便著手推進相關監管程序，並與阿里、百度共同開發針對中國市場設計的 AI 功能。
不過，此前外界所知多半停留在「誰與蘋果合作」的層面。這次官方使用手冊的更新，則首度將合作內容具體落實到使用者體驗上。
Siri 能調用千問，寫作工具也能調用千問，這代表千問所獲得的，並不僅僅是「預裝 App」的位置，而是切入了蘋果系統最核心的 AI 入口。
分析指出，這起合作背後，反映的是蘋果 AI 策略的一次根本轉向。
過去的智慧型手機時代，蘋果向來習慣將核心軟體能力牢牢握在自己手中：晶片自行設計、作業系統自行開發、Siri 也是自家產品。
然而，進入生成式 AI 時代後，大型模型更新速度飛快、訓練成本居高不下，加上各國監管與資料規範差異極大，蘋果因此開始將 Apple Intelligence 打造成更具彈性的分層架構。
在最底層，蘋果仍仰賴自研的 Apple Silicon 晶片與裝置端模型處理大量個人化任務，並持續強調裝置端運算對隱私保護的重要性；但當使用者提出的問題較為複雜、需要更強大的模型能力時，系統便會轉而呼叫外部模型支援。
這種做法蘋果在海外市場其實已有先例，如今則將角色交棒給中國本土 AI 廠商。
也就是說，蘋果正嘗試建立一條全新的「AI 供應鏈」：自己掌控作業系統、硬體與使用者入口，底層模型能力則依市場需求選擇不同供應商。

對阿里而言：比裝進 iPhone 更重要的位置

對阿里巴巴來說，這次合作的意義同樣深遠。
分析指出，過去一年，中國大型模型市場競爭日趨白熱化，各家廠商不僅比拚模型能力, 更積極爭奪使用者入口。
阿里自家的千問 App 持續擴充辦公、生活服務、AI 代理與圖像影片生成等功能，試圖直接對消費者端發力。
然而，蘋果所提供的，卻是完全不同性質的入口。它不需要使用者特意想到「我要用 AI」再另外開啟應用程式，而是讓 AI 直接融入使用者原本就在使用的系統功能之中。
分析認為，這等於是把大型模型從一項獨立產品，轉化為作業系統背後的基礎能力。
值得一提的是，英國《金融時報》本週在分析阿里最新模型 Qwen 3.8-Max 時也指出，阿里正嘗試將 AI 打造為新的技術與商業成長引擎，阿里雲則在模型能力商業化過程中扮演關鍵角色。
若未來數以千萬計的中國蘋果裝置都能透過系統功能呼叫千問，阿里所獲得的將不只是龐大的調用量，更包含一項極具份量的產業背書，證明其大型模型有能力成為全球最大消費電子生態系之一的底層 AI 供應商。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) and Alibaba (09988-HK) have been collaborating on artificial intelligence (AI) projects, and this collaboration is no longer just a rumor or a regulatory filing, but is now officially written into Apple's product documentation.
Recently, a netizen discovered that Apple's official Chinese website has added a new page to the Mac user manual, titled 'Using Apple Intelligence with Qwen on Mac'.
This means that Alibaba's large language model, Qwen, has officially become an essential component of the Apple Intelligence system in China.
According to Apple's explanation, Qwen is not presented as a standalone application, but is deeply embedded in the core functionality of Apple Intelligence.

For example, when Siri is unable to fully answer a complex question, the system will call Qwen in the background to supplement the response content, including in-depth analysis of photos and files; in Apple's writing tools, users can also use Qwen to generate text or image content based on text descriptions.

In other words, most users may not need to actively open the Qwen app, but can use the Chinese native model's computing power in the background when using Siri to ask questions, analyze files, or activate AI writing functions.

In fact, Apple and Alibaba's collaboration has been evident for some time. In July, Reuters reported that Apple Intelligence-related generative AI services had completed the registration process with Chinese regulatory authorities; to meet the requirements of the Chinese market, Apple chose to cooperate with Alibaba and Baidu (BIDU-US) simultaneously, with Alibaba's Qwen model being integrated into iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS, among other system platforms.

The Wall Street Journal had previously reported that Apple had begun pushing related regulatory procedures as early as January 2025 and was working with Alibaba and Baidu to develop AI functions tailored for the Chinese market.

However, prior to this, most of the information known to the outside world was limited to 'who is cooperating with Apple.' This time, the official update of the user manual has brought the cooperation content to the user experience for the first time.

Siri can call Qwen, and the writing tool can also call Qwen, which means that Qwen's capabilities are not limited to being a 'pre-installed app,' but have entered the core AI entry point of the Apple system.
Analysts point out that this cooperation reflects a fundamental shift in Apple's AI strategy.

In the era of intelligent phones, Apple has always preferred to keep core software capabilities in its own hands: designing its own chips, developing its own operating systems, and Siri is also a self-owned product.

However, with the advent of generative AI, large models update at a rapid pace, training costs are high, and there are significant differences in regulations and data standards across countries, Apple has begun to transform Apple Intelligence into a more flexible, multi-layered architecture.

At the bottom layer, Apple still relies on its self-designed Apple Silicon chips and device-end models to handle a large number of personalized tasks, and continues to emphasize the importance of device-end computation for privacy protection; but when users ask complex questions that require more powerful model capabilities, the system will call external models for support.
This approach has already been seen in Apple's overseas markets, and now it is passing the baton to Chinese native AI vendors.

In other words, Apple is trying to establish a new 'AI supply chain': controlling the operating system, hardware, and user interface, while relying on different suppliers for bottom-layer model capabilities based on market demand.
For Alibaba, this cooperation has a deeper significance.

Analysts point out that over the past year, the Chinese large model market has become increasingly competitive, with various vendors not only competing in model capabilities but also actively competing for user entry points.
Alibaba's own Qwen app has been continuously expanding its office, life services, AI agents, and image and video generation functions, trying to directly attack the consumer end.

However, Apple's offering is of a completely different nature. It does not require users to think 'I want to use AI' and then open an application separately, but instead integrates AI directly into the user's existing system functions.
Analysts believe that this is equivalent to transforming large models from a standalone product to a fundamental capability behind the operating system.

It's worth noting that the Financial Times analyzed Alibaba's latest model Qwen 3.8-Max this week and pointed out that Alibaba is trying to turn AI into a new technology and business growth engine, with Alibaba Cloud playing a key role in the commercialization of model capabilities.

If millions of Apple devices in China can call Qwen through system functions in the future, Alibaba will not only gain a massive number of calls, but also a significant industry endorsement, proving that its large model has the ability to become a bottom-layer AI supplier for one of the world's largest consumer electronics ecosystems.

items.title: CPU恐成雲端業下一個瓶頸！亞馬遜AWS出現「CPU短缺」
items.title_en: CPU May Become the Next Bottleneck for Cloud Industry as Amazon AWS Faces "CPU Shortage"
paras: 科技業已經從聚焦於 GPU 一片難求的窘境，轉向 CPU 這項基礎運算資源。
根據《The Information》報導，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 雲端服務（AWS）內部今年 5 月已對工程團隊發出示警，要求全力節省運算資源，以確保未來能持續滿足客戶需求。
值得注意的是，這波節流令不僅鎖定 AI 晶片，更直指長年支撐網路服務運作的傳統 CPU 伺服器。
知情人士透露，AWS 已對各部門下達期限，要求在今年稍晚前削減運算資源的占用比例。為了騰出算力轉供外部客戶使用，工程師們正陸續關閉先前用於軟體開發、如今處於閒置狀態的 EC2 虛擬伺服器。
一名任職 AWS 多年的工程師表示，過去申請 CPU 伺服器資源通常數小時內就能到位，如今卻得苦候數天之久，這樣的延遲在他的職涯中前所未見，甚至可能拖累專案交付時程。
對此，AWS 官方回應強調，儘管當前面臨「龐大需求」，公司仍有能力滿足「絕大多數」內外部客戶的運算需求，並表示正與內部團隊密切合作，確保 EC2 資源維持一貫的高效運用，員工使用資源的相關指引也未因目前的緊張情勢而調整。
值得留意的是，外部客戶目前受到的衝擊仍屬有限。一名協助企業導入 AWS 服務的顧問指出，尚未觀察到客戶在合約承諾的算力上出現實際短缺。
不過，AWS 以折扣價提供、但可隨時在兩分鐘內被收回的「競價執行個體」（Spot Instances），近幾個月來已越來越難大量取得，被視為 AWS 整體供需缺口正在收窄、彈性空間持續壓縮的明確訊號，也可能預示雲端運算成本即將走高。
分析指出，這波 CPU 吃緊的根本原因，在於「AI 代理」應用的快速擴散。AI 顧問公司 Elendil Labs 共同創辦人暨董事總經理 Jing Xie 觀察到，客戶的人均 IT 支出已然翻倍，主因正是企業內大量導入 AI 代理程式協助軟體開發。
他指出，AI 代理程式在運作過程中往往需要調用比以往更多的雲端資源，進而對 CPU 形成持續性的龐大需求。
他表示：「不論是現在的開發、生產或營運，幾乎所有工作所需的 CPU 都比過去更多。」
事實上，CPU 的角色不僅限於 AI 應用的執行端，在 AI 開發流程中同樣不可或缺。例如 AI 公司為訓練模型準備資料時，仍須仰賴 CPU 從文件、影像與影片中讀取並處理原始資料。
晶片大廠的最新表態也印證了這股趨勢。英特爾 (INTC-US) 執行長陳立武（Lip-Bu Tan）今年 4 月的財報電話會議上曾透露，在 AI 推論（即模型實際運作）情境中，CPU 與 GPU 的使用比例約為 1 比 4。
然而，到了 7 月，該公司財務長 David Zinsner 便指出這項比例已迅速拉近至接近 1 比 1。
超微半導體 (AMD-US) 與 Arm(ARM-US) 的高層主管近期也做出類似表態，顯示 CPU 需求成長的速度已超出業界原先預期。
除了 CPU 本身供不應求，與之搭配使用的記憶體晶片供應緊張，以及資料中心實體空間的限制，也共同加劇了這場算力荒。
大型科技公司的算力分配難題
如何在內部研發與外部客戶之間分配有限算力，已成為近兩年科技巨頭共同面臨的棘手課題。
根據《The Information》先前報導，Google 去年已成立一個由高階主管組成的專責委員會，負責協調 Google Cloud、DeepMind 研究部門與消費端業務之間的運算資源分配。
即便如此，內部摩擦仍未消弭。Google 知名 AI 研究員 Noam Shazeer 今年稍早便因不滿算力取得受限而選擇離職。
相較之下，微軟則展現出算力管理效率提升所帶來的正面效益。該公司財務長 Amy Hood 上月在財報電話會議上表示，Azure 雲端服務部分營收成長，正是得益於 CPU 與 GPU 叢集管理效率的提升。
paras_en: The tech industry has shifted its focus from the scarce GPU shortage to the fundamental computing resource of CPUs.

According to a report by The Information, Amazon (AMZN-US) cloud services (AWS) internally issued a warning to engineering teams in May of this year, urging them to conserve computing resources to ensure continued customer demand can be met.
Notably, this throttling effort targets not only AI chips but also the traditional CPU servers that have long underpinned network services.

Sources familiar with the matter say AWS has set deadlines for each division to reduce the proportion of computing resources they consume later this year. To free up capacity for external customers, engineers are gradually shutting down EC2 virtual servers that were previously used for software development and are now idle.

An engineer who has worked at AWS for many years said that in the past, requesting CPU server resources could be fulfilled within a few hours, but now it can take several days—a delay he has never seen in his career and one that could even jeopardize project delivery timelines.

AWS responded that despite the "massive demand" currently faced, the company remains capable of meeting the computing needs of "the vast majority" of internal and external customers, and that it is working closely with internal teams to keep EC2 resources efficiently utilized, with no changes to employee resource‑use guidelines despite the current tight situation.

It is worth noting that the impact on external customers remains limited. A consultant who helps enterprises adopt AWS services said he has not yet observed any actual shortfall in the compute capacity promised under customer contracts.

However, AWS’s discounted Spot Instances, which can be reclaimed at any time within two minutes, have become increasingly difficult to obtain in large quantities over the past few months, a clear sign that the overall supply‑demand gap is narrowing and flexibility is being squeezed, potentially foreshadowing higher cloud‑computing costs.

Analysts point out that the root cause of the CPU crunch is the rapid proliferation of "AI agents" applications. Jing Xie, co‑founder and managing director of AI consultancy Elendil Labs, observed that per‑capita IT spending by customers has doubled, driven largely by the massive adoption of AI agent programs to assist software development within enterprises.
He noted that AI agent programs typically require far more cloud resources during operation, creating a sustained, massive demand for CPUs.
He said, "Whether in development, production, or operations, almost every task now needs more CPU than before."

In fact, the role of CPUs extends beyond the execution side of AI applications; they are also indispensable in the AI development pipeline. For example, when AI companies prepare data for model training, they still rely on CPUs to read and process raw data from documents, images, and videos.

The latest statements from chip makers confirm this trend. Intel (INTC-US) CEO Lip‑Bu Tan disclosed in the April earnings call that in AI inference scenarios, the CPU‑to‑GPU usage ratio is about 1 to 4.
However, by July, the company’s CFO David Zinsner noted that the ratio had quickly narrowed to nearly 1 to 1.
Senior executives at AMD (AMD-US) and Arm (ARM-US) have made similar remarks recently, indicating that CPU demand growth is outpacing industry expectations.
In addition to the shortage of CPUs themselves, tight supplies of memory chips used alongside them and constraints on physical data‑center space are jointly exacerbating this compute scarcity.
Large tech companies face compute allocation challenges
How to allocate limited compute between internal R&D and external customers has become a thorny issue that major tech giants have grappled with over the past two years.

According to earlier reporting by The Information, Google established a high‑level committee last year to coordinate compute resource allocation among Google Cloud, DeepMind research, and consumer‑facing businesses.
Nevertheless, internal friction persists. Google AI researcher Noam Shazeer left the company earlier this year over frustrations with limited compute access.

In contrast, Microsoft has demonstrated the positive effects of improved compute management efficiency. CFO Amy Hood said last month in the earnings call that Azure’s revenue growth was driven in part by better CPU and GPU cluster management.

items.title: 輝達砸30億美元押注AI電力基建！傳入股Lancium 20%、布局「星際之門」資料中心
items.title_en: Nvidia Pours $3 B into AI Power Infrastructure, Takes 20% Stake in Lancium and Plans “Stargate” Data Center
paras: 人工智慧（AI）晶片龍頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 傳出將對電力基礎建設開發商 Lancium 挹注最高 30 億美元資金，這家公司正是德州「星際之門」（Stargate）資料中心園區的幕後推手。
根據《The Information》報導，報導引述知情人士說法指出，輝達首波將投入 20 億美元，取得 Lancium 約 20% 股權。
Lancium 背後金主為私募巨頭黑石集團（Blackstone），若後續達成特定門檻，例如電網併接進度符合預期，輝達不排除再加碼 10 億美元。
以此次交易計算，Lancium 旗下土地與電力連結資產組合，企業價值約達 100 億美元。
報導指出，這筆資金將協助 Lancium 加速業務擴張，該公司目前正評估在 2027 年推動首次公開發行（IPO）的可能性。
截至目前，輝達與 Lancium 均未對外界的求證要求作出回應。
值得注意的是，Lancium 正是「星際之門」計畫的關鍵基礎建設夥伴。該計畫由軟銀（SoftBank）、OpenAI 與甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 三方合資推動，目標是打造支撐 AI 發展的大型資料中心網路。
美國總統川普今年 1 月宣布此案時曾表示，相關企業合計將投入最高 5000 億美元資金，用於建設 AI 所需的基礎設施。
Lancium 目前在德州阿比林（Abilene）擁有一座占地 1000 英畝的「Lancium 潔淨園區」，該園區也是「星際之門」計畫首個正式啟用的營運據點。
paras_en: AI chip leader Nvidia (NVDA-US) is reported to be injecting up to $3 billion into power‑infrastructure developer Lancium, the company behind Texas’s “Stargate” data‑center campus.
According to The Information, insiders say Nvidia’s first tranche will be $2 billion for roughly a 20% equity stake in Lancium.
Lancium’s backer is private‑equity giant Blackstone, and if certain milestones—such as grid‑connection progress—are met, Nvidia may add another $1 billion.
Based on the deal, Lancium’s land and power‑linked asset portfolio is valued at about $10 billion.
The funding will help Lancium accelerate its expansion, and the firm is currently evaluating the possibility of an initial public offering in 2027.
To date, neither Nvidia nor Lancium has responded to external verification requests.

It is notable that Lancium is the key infrastructure partner for the “Stargate” project, a joint venture by SoftBank, OpenAI and Oracle (ORCL-US) aimed at building a large data‑center network to support AI development.
When President Trump announced the project in January, he said the participating companies could collectively invest up to $500 billion in AI‑related infrastructure.
Lancium currently operates a 1,000‑acre “Lancium Clean Campus” in Abilene, Texas, which is the first operational site of the “Stargate” initiative.

items.title: AI投資恐成下一個經濟風險？阿波羅警告「次貸危機式」逆轉衝擊
items.title_en: AI Investment May Become the Next Economic Risk? Apollo Warns of 'Subprime Crisis-Style' Reversal Impact
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設的投資熱潮正以史無前例的速度席捲全球資本市場，但這股熱潮背後所潛藏的總體經濟風險，也逐漸浮上檯面。
阿波羅資產管理（Apollo Management）首席經濟學家 Torsten Slok 近日分析指出，若干大型雲端服務業者的資本支出佔美國 GDP 比重，預估將從 2025 年的 1.4%，在短短兩、三年內躍升至 2027 至 2029 年間的約 3%，屆時規模將是 1990 年代末電信與光纖建設熱潮巔峰時期的兩倍以上。
Slok 在報告中將這波 AI 投資熱潮與過去兩大資本支出週期並列比較。就投資佔 GDP 的絕對規模而言，這波資料中心建設熱潮仍遜於 2005 年美國房市泡沫巔峰時期（當時佔 GDP 高達 6.6%），但已是 1990 年代末電信熱潮巔峰（約 1.2%）的兩倍以上。
然而，真正令 Slok 警覺的並非投資規模本身，而是「爬升速度」。他指出，資料中心資本支出佔 GDP 比重預計將從 2023 年的 0.6%，在短短四年內攀升至 2027 年的 3.1%，累計增幅約 2.5 個百分點，已超越房市榮景期間（1990 年代中期至 2005 年）約 2.2 個百分點的累計增幅，也遠高於當年電信熱潮僅 0.4 個百分點的漲幅。
換言之，若以「對 GDP 邊際貢獻」這項指標衡量，AI 資料中心投資已躍居史上規模最大的資本支出週期。
更值得留意的是建設節奏本身。報告顯示，資料中心資本支出僅用兩年時間，就從 2025 年的 1.4% 衝上 2027 年的 3.1%，換算下來，每年平均攀升約 0.85 個百分點。
相較之下，房市榮景最猛烈的階段（2002 年至 2005 年）年均增幅僅約 0.5 個百分點，電信熱潮更僅有 0.15 個百分點左右。
也就是說，這波 AI 建設狂潮的推進速度，幾乎是當年房市榮景高峰期的兩倍。
Slok 在報告中強調一項對稱性的邏輯：投資週期攀升得有多快，一旦反轉，衝擊力道恐怕也同樣猛烈。
他援引兩段歷史經驗作為對照：

2000 年前後電信泡沫破裂時，由於投資規模相對有限，對美國經濟造成的衝擊也較為溫和，僅引發戰後歷來最輕微的一次衰退；
反觀 2006 年初至 2008 年底，房市投資佔 GDP 比重在短短三年內急速萎縮約 3.2 個百分點，正是釀成後續金融危機與嚴重衰退的關鍵推手之一。


以此類推，如今資料中心資本支出正以每年約 0.85 個百分點的速度加速擴張，一旦企業對 AI 的商業化預期未能如期兌現，這股資金浪潮同樣可能以相近的速度急遽收縮。
Slok 在報告結語中直言，當前總體經濟層面真正需要關注的風險，並非 AI 基礎建設本身的擴張，而是一旦市場對 AI 的殷切期待落空，隨之而來的投資急遽反轉，恐將對整體經濟成長帶來難以忽視的衝擊。
paras_en: The investment boom in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure is sweeping the global capital market at an unprecedented pace, but the overall economic risks hidden behind this boom are gradually emerging.

Torsten Slok, the chief economist of Apollo Management, recently analyzed that the capital expenditure of some large cloud service providers as a percentage of US GDP is expected to jump from 1.4% in 2025 to around 3% in 2027-2029, which will be more than twice the peak of the telecom and fiber construction boom in the late 1990s.

In his report, Slok compared this AI investment boom with the two major capital expenditure cycles in the past. In terms of the absolute scale of investment as a percentage of GDP, this data center construction boom is still smaller than the peak of the US housing market bubble in 2005 (which accounted for 6.6% of GDP), but it is more than twice the peak of the telecom boom in the late 1990s (around 1.2%).

However, what really alerted Slok was not the scale of investment itself, but the 'speed of ascent'. He pointed out that the capital expenditure of data centers as a percentage of GDP is expected to rise from 0.6% in 2023 to 3.1% in 2027, with a cumulative increase of about 2.5 percentage points, which has surpassed the cumulative increase of about 2.2 percentage points during the housing boom period (from the mid-1990s to 2005) and is much higher than the 0.4 percentage point increase during the telecom boom.
In other words, if measured by the 'marginal contribution to GDP', AI data center investment has become the largest capital expenditure cycle in history.

More noteworthy is the pace of construction itself. The report shows that data center capital expenditure will rise from 1.4% in 2025 to 3.1% in 2027 in just two years, which translates to an average annual increase of about 0.85 percentage points.

In comparison, the most intense phase of the housing boom (2002-2005) had an average annual increase of only about 0.5 percentage points, while the telecom boom had an increase of only about 0.15 percentage points.
That is to say, the pace of this AI construction boom is almost twice that of the housing boom at its peak.
Sloak emphasized a symmetrical logic in his report: the faster the investment cycle rises, the more severe the impact will be when it reverses.

He cited two historical experiences as a contrast: around 2000, when the telecom bubble burst, the impact on the US economy was relatively mild due to the limited scale of investment, resulting in the mildest recession in the post-war period.

On the other hand, from 2006 to 2008, the housing investment as a percentage of GDP shrank rapidly by about 3.2 percentage points in just three years, which was a key factor leading to the subsequent financial crisis and severe recession.

By analogy, if the current data center capital expenditure is expanding at a rate of about 0.85 percentage points per year, and the commercialization expectations of AI are not met, this wave of investment may also shrink rapidly at a similar rate.

items.title: 美國7月非農疲軟不代表經濟衰退？貝萊德：AI正讓就業數據失效、升息「已無意義」
items.title_en: US July Non-Farm Payrolls Softness May Not Indicate Economic Recession: BlackRock's Rick Rieder
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業數據意外轉冷，市場普遍將其視為經濟走弱的前兆。然而，貝萊德 (BLK-US) 全球固定收益部門首席投資長里德（Rick Rieder）卻提出截然不同的看法，認為就業疲軟背後真正的驅動力，其實是人工智慧（AI）帶動的生產力革命，正從根本上重塑勞動市場的運作方式。
里德曾是角逐美國聯準會（Fed）主席大位的熱門人選之一，其分析直指傳統總體經濟框架的盲點。他強調，投資人與政策制定者不應再機械式地將就業數字疲弱等同於整體經濟走弱。
里德分析，AI 技術大舉滲透職場、企業對營運效率的極致追求，加上移民數量大幅萎縮導致可用勞動力縮減，三股力量正在同時發酵，使得非農就業數字作為經濟景氣指標的參考價值大打折扣。
他認為，就業人數下滑其實反映的是美國企業正在摸索出一套「不必擴編也能提高產出」的營運模式。
這項觀點並非憑空臆測，數據面確實提供了一定佐證。過去十六個季度以來，美國勞動生產率僅出現過一次下滑，整體生產效率相較 2010 年代已明顯提升。
研究機構 22V Research 的調查也指出，標普 500 指數成分股中，約有 25 家企業已具體量化 AI 對公司獲利的貢獻，平均為利潤率帶來 180 個基點的提升。
值得注意的是，AI 帶來的獲利提升效應並不局限於科技產業。美國廢棄物管理公司透露，其導入的「智慧卡車」系統透過服務優化、路線調度與成本控管，每年可貢獻超過 3 億美元的息稅折舊攤銷前利潤（EBITDA）。
保險經紀暨顧問公司 Willis Towers Watson 同樣表示，透過流程自動化，預計可實現 4 億美元的成本節省。
除了對非農數據提出新解讀外，里德也對貨幣政策的有效性提出質疑。
他直言，如今再度升息「意義不大」，並坦言：「我不認為調整隔夜聯邦資金利率真的能解決問題。這種情況我們過去也見過。」
在他看來，若當前的通膨壓力主要源自 AI 重塑生產結構、移民政策改變勞動供給等結構性因素，那麼傳統上依賴壓抑總需求來發揮作用的升息工具，效果恐怕將愈發有限。
他因此主張，與其持續收緊貨幣政策，不如透過鬆綁法規、改革住宅許可制度，以及推動學貸減免等財政手段，或許更能有效緩解通膨壓力。
這套總體觀點也具體反映在里德的資產配置策略上。他透露，旗下基金目前較看好歐洲固定收益資產、新興市場資產以及證券化資產，相較之下，對美國投資級企業債則興趣缺缺，直言目前「吸引力確實不高」，主因在於該市場正面臨大量新增供給的壓力，恐將壓抑價格表現。
paras_en: US July non-farm payrolls unexpectedly cooled, with the market widely viewing it as a harbinger of economic weakness. However, BlackRock's (BLK-US) Global Fixed Income Chief Investment Officer Rick Rieder presents a starkly different view, arguing that the underlying driver of employment softness is actually the productivity revolution brought about by artificial intelligence (AI), which is fundamentally reshaping the way labor markets operate.

Rieder, a former hot contender for the US Federal Reserve (Fed) chair position, points out that traditional macroeconomic frameworks are blind to this reality. He emphasizes that investors and policymakers should no longer mechanically equate weak employment numbers with overall economic weakness.

Rieder's analysis highlights three key factors driving the shift: AI technology's widespread adoption in the workplace, companies' relentless pursuit of operational efficiency, and a significant decline in immigration, which has reduced the available labor force. These three forces are simultaneously fermenting, rendering non-farm payrolls as a reference point for economic sentiment increasingly irrelevant.
He believes that the decline in employment numbers actually reflects US companies' experimentation with a new operational model that can boost output without expanding headcount.

This perspective is not based on speculation; data provides some evidence. Over the past 16 quarters, US labor productivity has only declined once, and overall efficiency has improved significantly compared to the 2010s.

Research firm 22V Research's study also found that approximately 25 S&P 500 constituent companies have quantified the contribution of AI to their profits, with an average increase of 180 basis points in earnings.

Notably, the profit-enhancing effect of AI is not limited to the tech sector. Waste management company Waste Management revealed that its 'smart truck' system, which optimizes services, routes, and costs, contributes over $3 billion in EBITDA annually.
Insurance broker and consultant Willis Towers Watson also stated that it expects to achieve $4 billion in cost savings through process automation.
In addition to reinterpreting non-farm data, Rieder also questions the effectiveness of monetary policy.
He bluntly states that further rate hikes 'are not meaningful' and admits, 'I don't think adjusting the federal funds rate overnight really solves the problem. We've seen this before.'

In his view, if the current inflation pressure is primarily driven by structural factors such as AI's reshaping of production structures and changes in immigration policies, then the traditional tool of suppressing aggregate demand through rate hikes will likely become increasingly ineffective.

He therefore advocates for using fiscal measures such as relaxing regulations, reforming housing permits, and promoting student loan forgiveness to alleviate inflation pressure, rather than continuing to tighten monetary policy.

This overall perspective is also reflected in Rieder's asset allocation strategy. He reveals that his funds currently have a higher preference for European fixed income assets, emerging market assets, and securitized assets, while showing less interest in US investment-grade corporate bonds, stating that 'the attractiveness is indeed not high' due to the market's pressure from a large influx of new supply, which may suppress price performance.

items.title: 美國7月非農轉弱華爾街卻嗨翻？Fed升息預期降溫、科技股黃金狂飆
items.title_en: U.S. July Nonfarm Payrolls Weaken Yet Wall Street Celebrates? Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations Cool, Tech Stocks and Gold Surge
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業人數意外減少 2.3 萬人，照理說應是壞消息，但華爾街卻交出自 4 月以來最亮眼的單週表現。這看似矛盾的市場反應，其實反映出 2026 年以來投資人心中最大的糾結：聯準會（Fed）原本被市場預期下一步將升息，然而就業人數縮減，使這一選項暫時被排除在外。
根據《Benzinga》報導，市場原先預估 7 月就業人數將增加約 8 萬人，但政府部門的招聘表現不佳，非農就業人數反而減少 5.3 萬人。私人企業則仍增加 3 萬個工作職位，但遠低於市場預期的 7.8 萬個。
失業率雖從 4.2% 降至 4.1%，但這並非經濟強勁的訊號。勞動力人口減少 26.4 萬人，勞動參與率滑落至 61.4%，創下 2021 年初以來新低。
更值得關注的是前值大幅下修：5 月與 6 月合計下修 10.3 萬個工作機會，使過去三個月的就業趨勢遠比市場原先認知的更為疲弱。
薪資成長方面，時薪年增率為 3.2%，是 2021 年以來最慢的增速。

壞消息如何買到一場派對

分析指出，就業數據轉弱，等於拿掉了聯準會升息的理由。根據芝商所（CME）FedWatch 工具，市場預期 9 月升息的機率從 58% 驟降至 42%。
利率預期下滑帶動美債殖利率與美元同步走低，成為推動長期科技股和黃金兩種資產上漲的最可靠動力。追蹤標普 500 指數的 SPDR 標準普爾 500 指數 ETF(SPY-US) 單週勁揚 3.5%，寫下 4 月中以來最佳週表現。
同時，追蹤那斯達克 100 指數的景順 QQQ Trust, Series 1(QQQ-US) 單週亦大漲 4.8%，創下 5 月初以來最強紀錄。
黃金週五（7 日）更是勁揚 2.4%，來到每盎司 4,347.70 美元的七週新高，單週漲幅約 7.5%，寫下七個月來最強一週。

個股表現冰火兩極

本週表現最亮眼的個股當屬光子元件廠 Coherent(COHR-US) ，五個交易日大漲 43.5%。
該公司生產連接 AI 晶片的光學傳輸元件，受惠於同業財報表現、美國傳出將加嚴對中國光學收發器的出口限制，加上摩根大通將目標價從 380 美元上調至 435 美元，股價因而重新獲得市場青睞。該公司將於下週三（12 日）公布財報。
軟體業者 Palantir(PLTR-US) 則交出本週最亮眼的財報。第二季營收年增 93% 至 19.4 億美元，美國商業營收更暴增 149%，全年營收指引上修至 81.5 億美元。
執行長 Alex Karp 形容成績「超乎尋常」，Palantir 股價週二（4 日）單日大漲近 29%，創下該公司史上最佳單日表現之一。
條碼與倉儲自動化廠商斑馬科技 (ZBRA-US) 則是本週的驚喜黑馬，調整後每股獲利 6.35 美元，遠高於市場預期的 4.36 美元，優於預期達 45%；營收成長 20.4% 至 15.6 億美元，全年財測上修至 20.75 至 21.25 美元區間。
相較之下，財測疲軟的公司則慘遭市場拋售。廣告科技公司交易台 (TTD-US) 市值蒸發約四分之一，儘管營收成長 3% 至 7.151 億美元，但第三季營收指引僅約 6.5 億美元，遠低於市場預期的 8.05 億美元，公司同時宣布撤換財務長、行銷長與商務長。
從 Honeywell 分拆出來、6 月才獨立掛牌的 Honeywell Aerospace (HONA-US) 首份財報即下修全年有機營收成長指引，由原先的 7% 至 9% 調降至 4% 至 5%。
腎臟透析服務商德維特 (DVA-US) 雖然財報優於預期，股價卻重挫 17%，原因在於公司僅維持原有財測，而非上調，且該財測中值原本就低於市場共識。

焦點轉向下週 CPI

報導指出，市場目光現在轉向 8 月 12 日公布的 7 月消費者物價指數（CPI）。經濟學家預期整體通膨率將從 3.5% 降至 3.4%，剔除食品與能源的核心通膨率則預估從 2.6% 放緩至 2.5%。
若數據溫和，市場對 9 月升息的預期可能將進一步降溫；反之若通膨數據意外偏熱，升息疑慮恐將捲土重來，屆時本週領漲的黃金、小型股與長天期科技股，恐怕也將出現回調。
另一方面，號稱 2026 年表現最佳半導體股之一的應用材料 (AMAT-US) ，將於週四（13 日）美股盤後公布財報，市場屆時也將密切關注。
分析指出，疲弱的就業數據，這次為華爾街買到了一場慶祝行情；但下週的 CPI 數據，才是決定這場派對能否延續下去的關鍵。
paras_en: U.S. July nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly fell by 23,000, which on the surface looks like bad news, yet Wall Street delivered its strongest weekly performance since April. This seemingly contradictory market reaction actually reflects the biggest dilemma investors have faced since 2026: the Fed was expected to raise rates next, but the drop in employment numbers temporarily removed that option.

According to Benzinga, the market had originally forecast about an 80,000 increase in July jobs, but weak hiring in the government sector caused nonfarm payrolls to decline by 53,000. Private firms still added 30,000 jobs, far below the market’s expectation of 78,000.

The unemployment rate fell from 4.2% to 4.1%, but this is not a sign of a strong economy. The labor force shrank by 264,000 and the labor‑participation rate slipped to 61.4%, a low not seen since early 2021.

Even more noteworthy is the large downward revision of prior figures: May and June combined were revised down by 103,000 jobs, making the employment trend over the past three months considerably weaker than the market had originally believed.
On wages, the hourly earnings growth rate slowed to 3.2% year‑over‑year, the slowest pace since 2021.

How to buy a party out of bad news? Analysts note that the weaker jobs data removed the rationale for a Fed rate hike. Using CME’s FedWatch tool, the probability of a September hike dropped sharply from 58% to 42%.

The dip in rate expectations pulled U.S. Treasury yields and the dollar lower, providing the most reliable catalyst for gains in long‑term tech stocks and gold. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY‑US) jumped 3.5% for the week, its best weekly performance since mid‑April.
At the same time, the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 (QQQ‑US), which tracks the Nasdaq‑100, surged 4.8% for the week, its strongest showing since early May.
Gold rallied 2.4% on Friday (the 7th), reaching a seven‑week high of $4,347.70 per ounce, up about 7.5% for the week and marking its best week in seven months.
Stock performance was polarized. The standout performer was photonics component maker Coherent (COHR‑US), which surged 43.5% over five trading days.

The company makes optical transmission components that connect AI chips, benefitting from peers’ earnings, news that the U.S. may tighten export limits on Chinese optical transceivers, and JPMorgan raising its target price from $380 to $435, prompting renewed market interest. Coherent will release its earnings next Wednesday (the 12th).

Software firm Palantir (PLTR‑US) delivered the most impressive earnings this week. Q2 revenue jumped 93% year‑over‑year to $1.94 billion, with U.S. commercial revenue soaring 149%, and full‑year revenue guidance was lifted to $8.15 billion.
CEO Alex Karp called the results “extraordinary,” and Palantir’s stock surged nearly 29% on Tuesday (the 4th), one of the best single‑day performances in the company’s history.

Barcode and warehouse‑automation company Zebra Technologies (ZBRA‑US) was a surprise dark horse, reporting adjusted earnings of $6.35 per share, well above the $4.36 consensus – a 45% beat – and revenue grew 20.4% to $1.56 billion, prompting an annual outlook upgrade to a $20.75‑$21.25 range.

In contrast, companies with weak guidance were hammered. Advertising‑tech firm The Trade Desk (TTD‑US) saw its market value evaporate by about a quarter; despite revenue growing 3% to $715.1 million, its Q3 revenue outlook of roughly $650 million fell far short of the $805 million consensus, and the firm announced the replacement of its CFO, CMO and CRO.
Honeywell Aerospace (HONA‑US), which spun out of Honeywell and listed in June, cut its full‑year organic revenue growth outlook from 7‑9% to 4‑5% in its first earnings release.

Dialysis provider DaVita (DVA‑US) posted earnings that beat expectations, yet its stock plunged 17% because the company left its guidance unchanged – and the midpoint of that guidance was already below market consensus.

The focus now shifts to next week’s CPI. Analysts say the market’s attention is on the July CPI to be released on August 12. Economists expect overall inflation to ease from 3.5% to 3.4%, with core inflation (excluding food and energy) slowing from 2.6% to 2.5%.

If the data come in mild, expectations for a September rate hike could cool further; if inflation surprises on the high side, rate‑hike concerns may resurface, potentially pulling back the gold, small‑cap and long‑duration tech stocks that led the market this week.

On the other hand, Applied Materials (AMAT‑US), touted as one of the best‑performing semiconductor stocks of 2026, will report earnings after the U.S. market close on Thursday (the 13th), and investors will be watching closely.
Analysts conclude that weak employment data gave Wall Street a celebratory rally this time, but next week’s CPI will be the key determinant of whether the party can continue.

items.title: DRAM供給恐緊缺至2030年！高盛示警：南韓記憶體股遭過度悲觀定價
items.title_en: DRAM supply feared scarce until 2030! Goldman warns: South Korea memory stocks overly pessimistically priced
paras: 高盛亞洲首爾分部交易員 Justin Park 近日發布最新研究報告指出，南韓股市近期劇烈震盪，已使投資人對記憶體晶片產業的基本面預期，壓低到明顯偏離現實的悲觀水準。
Park 強調，目前市場對記憶體晶片股的估值，並未反映這一輪景氣循環真正的強度與延續性。
報告分析，這波記憶體產業的多頭行情，主要動能來自 AI 運算需求快速擴張所引發的結構性供需失衡。
高盛預估，DRAM 供應短缺的情況可能一路延續到 2030 年，長期缺貨態勢將賦予相關廠商更強的定價權與獲利空間。
除基本面因素外，報告也點出市場技術面正在改善的訊號：槓桿型 ETF 的資金規模明顯收縮、保證金交易的曝險部位下降，加上主管機關監管力道轉趨嚴格，以及避險基金持倉部位逐步退場。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs' Seoul branch trader Justin Park recently released a new research report noting that the South Korean stock market's recent severe volatility has pushed investors' expectations for the memory chip industry's fundamentals down to a clearly unrealistic pessimistic level.
Park emphasized that current market valuations of memory chip stocks do not reflect the true strength and persistence of this economic cycle.
The report analysis says the bullish run in the memory industry is mainly driven by a structural supply‑demand imbalance caused by the rapid expansion of AI computing demand.
Goldman estimates that the DRAM supply shortage could persist all the way to 2030, and the long‑term scarcity will give related manufacturers stronger pricing power and profit margins.

Besides fundamentals, the report also points to improving technical signals: the asset base of leveraged ETFs has noticeably contracted, margin‑trading exposure has fallen, regulatory scrutiny has become stricter, and hedge‑fund positions are gradually exiting.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美非農就業人口意外減少 美元周線連二黑
items.title_en: New York Foreign Exchange Market: US Non-Farm Employment Population Decreases, Dollar Falls for Second Consecutive Week
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周五 (7 日) 走軟，美國 7 月非農就業人口意外減少，引發市場對美國經濟韌性的擔憂，也削弱了聯準會 (Fed) 升息的理由，進而拖累美元。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的 ICE 美元指數 (DXY) 下跌 0.44%，約報 99.50，本周共下跌 0.31%，連續第二周走軟。
美國勞工部公布，7 月非農就業人數減少 2.3 萬人，與路透調查經濟學家預期增加 8 萬人大相逕庭。美國失業率則降至 4.1%，但勞動參與率下滑至 61.4%，創近 5 年半低點。
就業報告公布後，美元兌日元貶值 0.57% 至 157.56 日元，但本周仍升值約 0.10%。由於美日當局上周聯合進行歷史性干預，美元兌日元一度跌至 13 周低點。
歐元兌美元上揚 0.39%，報 1.1568 美元，本周升值 0.41%。
美元走弱反映市場對 Fed 升息的預期降溫。根據芝商所 (CME) FedWatch 工具，市場目前預期 Fed 在 9 月維持利率不變的機率為 56%，高於前一日的 45%。
Macquarie Group 全球外匯及利率策略師 Thierry Wizman 說：「我認為，沒有人真的預期非農就業人數會出現負值，也沒有人預期 6 月就業數據會大幅下修。」
他進一步解釋：「我傾向認為，市場已將 Fed 升息時點從 9 月延後至 10 月或 12 月。每當數據顯示美國經濟疲弱，或勞動市場沒有原先認為的那麼強勁，市場就會把 Fed 升息的可能時點往後推。」
美國公債殖利率在就業報告公布後大幅下滑。通常追隨 Fed 利率預期走勢的 2 年期美債殖利率下跌 4.2 個基點，報 4.245%，基準的 10 年期美債殖利率下跌 2 個基點，報 4.649%。

paras_en: The US dollar softened against major currencies on Friday as the US non-farm employment population unexpectedly decreased in July, sparking concerns about the resilience of the US economy and weakening the case for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike, which in turn dragged down the dollar.

At the close of the New York market, the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar's movement against six major currencies, fell 0.44% to around 99.50, marking a 0.31% decline for the week and its second consecutive weekly drop.

The US Labor Department reported that non-farm employment decreased by 23,000 in July, contrary to the expected increase of 80,000 predicted by Reuters' survey of economists. The US unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, but the labor participation rate slid to 61.4%, a near 5.5-year low.

Following the release of the employment report, the dollar depreciated 0.57% against the yen to 157.56 yen but still appreciated about 0.10% for the week. The dollar-yen exchange rate had hit a 13-week low after the US and Japanese authorities conducted a historic intervention the previous week.
The euro rose 0.39% against the dollar to $1.1568, marking a 0.41% gain for the week.

The dollar's weakness reflects a cooling of expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently sees a 56% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged in September, up from 45% the previous day.

Thierry Wizman, a global foreign exchange and interest rate strategist at Macquarie Group, said, 'I think nobody really expected the non-farm payroll to be negative, and nobody expected the June employment numbers to be revised downward significantly.'

He further explained, 'I tend to think the market has pushed back the timing of the Fed's rate hike from September to October or December. Whenever the data shows the US economy is weaker or the labor market is not as strong as previously thought, the market pushes back the potential timing of the rate hike.'

US Treasury yields plummeted after the employment report was released. The 2-year Treasury yield, which typically tracks Fed rate expectations, fell 4.2 basis points to 4.245%, while the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield dropped 2 basis points to 4.649%.

The dollar index was reported at 99.5996, down 0.03438%. The euro-to-dollar (EUR/USD) exchange rate was reported at 1 euro to 1.1557 US dollars, up 0.29%. items.title: 日元又突然急升！非農爆冷還是美日再度干預？
items.title_en: Yen Suddenly Surges Again! Is It Due to Cold Non-Farm Data or US-Japan Intervention?
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業數據意外轉為負成長，重挫聯準會 (Fed) 升息預期，帶動美元全面走弱，日元兌美元周五 (7 日) 盤中突然大漲。由於美日當局才在數日前聯手進場支撐日元，交易員也高度警戒官方可能再度干預匯市。
美元兌日元一度重挫 1.1% 至 156.68 日元，隨後跌幅略為收斂，最新報 157.16 日元，已明顯遠離 7 月觸及的 163.99 日元、40 年來高點。
目前尚不清楚日本當局是否再次進場干預。不過，分析師指出，美國就業數據遠遜預期，加上美債殖利率大幅下跌，已足以促使投資人拋售美元，因此這波日元升勢可能主要由基本面因素推動。
三菱日聯金融集團 (MUFG) 資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，非農就業數據低於預期的幅度非常大，觀察美國殖利率曲線短端的劇烈反應，美元下跌並不令人意外。由於非農就業出現負值相當罕見，這次數據對 Fed 升息預期造成明顯打擊，市場理應出現強烈反應，美元也可能面臨廣泛賣壓。
美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 周五公布，7 月非農就業人口意外減少 2.3 萬人，6 月增幅則由原先公布的 5.7 萬人下修至 2 萬人。《路透》調查的經濟學家原先預估，7 月就業人口將增加 8 萬人，預測區間介於增加 1 萬至 14 萬人。
就業數據公布後不久，日本財務大臣表示，東京與華府一直保持「密切溝通」，必要時將毫不猶豫地干預匯市，進一步加深交易員戒心。
日本與美國上周五才罕見採取協調行動，共同買進日元，以阻止日元持續貶值。隨著疲弱非農數據為日元提供基本面支撐，加上美日官員持續釋出干預警告，市場正密切關注日元是否延續反彈，以及官方是否再次出手。
paras_en: The US 7-month non-farm employment data unexpectedly turned negative, severely undercutting the Federal Reserve's (Fed) interest rate hike expectations, leading to a sharp decline in the US dollar, and a sudden surge in the yen against the US dollar on Friday (7).

The US dollar against the yen plummeted by 1.1% to 156.68 yen, before narrowing its decline, and was last reported at 157.16 yen, clearly far removed from the 163.99 yen, a 40-year high touched in July.

It remains unclear whether Japanese authorities have intervened again in the foreign exchange market. However, analysts point out that the US employment data fell far short of expectations, coupled with a sharp decline in US Treasury yields, which is enough to prompt investors to sell the US dollar, and thus the yen's surge may be driven primarily by fundamental factors.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) senior foreign exchange analyst Lee Hardman stated that the non-farm employment data fell short of expectations by a very large margin, and observed a sharp reaction in the US short-term interest rate curve, making the decline in the US dollar not unexpected.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Friday that the non-farm employment population unexpectedly decreased by 23,000 in July, and the June increase was revised downward to 20,000 from the originally reported 57,000. Reuters' survey of economists had previously estimated that the employment population would increase by 800,000 in July, with a prediction range of 100,000 to 1.4 million.

Shortly after the release of employment data, Japan's Finance Minister stated that Tokyo and Washington have maintained 'close communication', and would intervene in the foreign exchange market without hesitation if necessary, further deepening the caution among traders.

Japan and the US took a rare coordinated action last Friday, jointly buying the yen to block its continued depreciation. With weak non-farm data providing fundamental support for the yen, and US and Japanese officials continuing to issue warnings of intervention, the market is closely watching whether the yen will continue its rebound, and whether officials will intervene again.

items.title: 美日罕見聯手干預日元 高盛：彰顯美元儲備貨幣霸權不可替代
items.title_en: US and Japan Unite to Intervene in Yen, Goldman Sachs: Highlighting the Irreplaceable Dominance of Dollar as Reserve Currency
paras: 近期美國與日本展開罕見的聯合干預行動以支撐日元匯率，此舉引發外界對於美元作為儲備貨幣吸引力的討論。然而，高盛集團周四 (6 日) 發表報告指出，這次事件反而凸顯了美元在國際金融體系中無可取代的優勢，其深厚的市場深度與流動性，讓各國央行在市場劇烈波動時能迅速調用儲備。
日元先前因持續走弱而跌至 40 年來的低點，在美日協同干預前，日元兌美元匯率約為 164，干預後回升至約 158 左右。雖然部分市場人士擔心華盛頓對國債市場採取的積極態度可能令儲備管理者感到不安，但高盛認為這種擔憂是「過度跳躍的推論」。
高盛分析師表示，現任政府展現出比以往更強的干預意願，這並不代表美國國債市場出現新的脆弱性，反而體現了美元儲備在關鍵時刻的實用性。
高盛強調，美國資本市場的深度讓各國央行在平時能穩健累積美元，並在面臨壓力時順暢提取。此外，美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 提議調高聯準會「外國及國際貨幣當局 (FIMA) 回購工具」的上限，這將允許各國央行透過抵押國債暫時換取美元，而非直接拋售國債，進而減少因突然拋售國債而產生的市場動盪。
儘管高盛也提到美元長期面臨美國制度不確定性等潛在風險，但日本的經驗再次證明，競爭對手難以企及美元的優勢。
報告結論指出：「當到了需要干預的時刻，絕大多數央行仍然需要美元。」
paras_en: The US and Japan have recently embarked on a rare joint intervention to support the yen, sparking discussions about the attractiveness of the dollar as a reserve currency. However, Goldman Sachs Group released a report on Thursday (6th) stating that this event has instead highlighted the dollar's irreplaceable dominance in the international financial system, with its deep market depth and liquidity allowing central banks to quickly draw on their reserves during market turmoil.

The yen had previously weakened to a 40-year low, with the exchange rate against the dollar around 164 before the joint intervention, and rebounded to around 158 after the intervention. Although some market participants are concerned that Washington's aggressive stance on the debt market may cause unease among reserve managers, Goldman Sachs believes this concern is an 'overly hasty inference'.

Goldman Sachs analysts point out that the current government has shown a stronger willingness to intervene, which does not represent a new vulnerability in the US debt market, but rather the practicality of dollar reserves in critical times.

Goldman Sachs emphasizes that the depth of the US capital market allows central banks to accumulate dollars stably in normal times and smoothly draw on them when facing pressure. Additionally, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent proposed increasing the ceiling for the Federal Reserve's 'Foreign and International Monetary Authorities (FIMA) Repurchase Agreement Tool', which would allow central banks to temporarily exchange dollars for securities through collateral, rather than directly selling securities, thereby reducing market volatility caused by sudden sales of securities.

Although Goldman Sachs also mentions that the dollar faces potential risks such as US institutional uncertainty in the long term, Japan's experience once again proves that competitors cannot match the dollar's superiority.
The report concludes: 'When it's time to intervene, almost all central banks still need dollars.'

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯齊挫！一度摜破32.3關卡 中止連2升收32.288元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar and Stock Index Suffer Losses as Tensions Rise
paras: 美伊緊張局勢再度升溫，台北股匯今 (7) 日同步走弱，新台幣兌美元匯率一度貶破 32.3 元關卡，不過，央行尾盤持續調節，終場貶幅收斂，收在 32.288 元、小貶 2.7 分，中止連二升，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 29.345 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 32.24 元，最高來到 32.2 元，但隨著美元買盤湧現，匯價由升轉貶，最低下探 32.35 元，不過，出口商伺機進場，加上央行也進場調節，帶動貶幅收斂，終場收在 32.288 元，小貶 2.7 分。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數上漲 0.20%，韓元強勢升值 0.66%，為本日最強亞幣，人民幣升值 0.07%，星幣微幅升值 0.02%，新台幣貶值 0.08%，日元重貶 0.34%，亞幣表現不同調。
台股今天一度上漲逾 430 點，但獲利了結賣壓出籠，指數翻黑下跌 170.79 點，終場收在 44225.91 點。外資賣超台股 407 億元。
受到市場對貨幣政策前景的不安情緒影響，美元周四表現支撐，投資人拋售美國公債，推升美債殖利率。市場把焦點轉向周五公布的 7 月非農就業報告，將成為聯準會利率走向的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: The Taiwan dollar and stock index suffered losses today as tensions between the US and Iran escalated, causing the dollar to rise against the Taiwan dollar. The Taiwan dollar fell to a low of 32.3 against the US dollar, but the central bank intervened to stabilize the market, resulting in a smaller loss of 2.7 points to close at 32.288.

The Taiwan dollar opened at 32.24 against the US dollar and rose to a high of 32.2, but then turned lower as dollar buying pressure increased. The lowest point was 32.35, but exporters and the central bank intervened to stabilize the market, resulting in a smaller loss of 2.7 points to close at 32.288.

The major currencies against the US dollar showed varying performances today, with the dollar index rising 0.20%, the Korean won rising 0.66% to become the strongest Asian currency, the Chinese yuan rising 0.07%, the Hong Kong dollar rising 0.02%, the Taiwan dollar falling 0.08%, the Japanese yen falling 0.34%, and the Asian currencies showing mixed performances.

The Taiwan stock index rose over 430 points at one point today, but then sold off due to profit-taking, resulting in a loss of 170.79 points to close at 44225.91. Foreign investors sold 407 billion Taiwan dollars worth of stocks.

The dollar rose today due to market concerns about monetary policy, with investors selling US bonds and pushing up the yield on US Treasury bonds. The market is now focusing on the release of the July non-farm employment report on Friday, which will be an important indicator of the Federal Reserve's interest rate decisions.

items.title: 日元已回吐近半干預漲幅 美日匯率保衛戰恐還有第二輪要打
items.title_en: Yen Gives Back Nearly Half of Intervention Gain, Fears of Second Round of Intervention Rise
paras: 日元兌美元匯率在經歷美日聯合干預後的強勁反彈後，近期已回吐近半漲幅，引發市場對於當局是否會發動「第二輪保衛戰」的熱烈討論。
截至周五下午，日元兌美元匯率跌至 158.40 附近，遠低於周一創下的 155.23 強勢高點。就在上周，日元兌美元一度逼近 164 的四十年低點，隨後引發日本與美國自 1998 年以來的首次聯合買入日元行動。
此次匯率回調凸顯了單純干預手段，在扭轉日元長期貶值趨勢上的局限性。美日之間顯著的利差、日本沉重的債務負擔，以及地緣政治不確定性均持續向日元施壓。隨著中東局勢導致油價上漲，市場對緊張局勢緩和的樂觀情緒減弱，支撐美元周四錄得兩周來最大單日漲幅。
市場分析指出，隨著匯率再度逼近 160 的關鍵整數關口，當局再次出手干預的可能性極高。
澳洲聯邦銀行策略師 Carol Kong 警告，若日元跌破 160 關口而當局未採取行動，將鼓勵交易員重新建立日元空頭部位，這正是政策制定者極力想避免的結果。事實上，日本在春季黃金周期間已曾三次干預匯市，顯示出其最大化心理衝擊的決心。
然而，干預的長效性仍取決於貨幣政策的配合。華僑銀行策略師 Moh Siong Sim 認為，干預若要發揮實質效果，必須配合日本央行更激進的升息，或是聯準會轉向寬鬆政策。目前，隔夜指數掉期顯示日本央行在 9 月前升息的機率約為 60%。
日本最高外匯事務官員三村淳表示，當局將協調匯率走勢與貨幣政策共同應對。
展望未來，美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 的「不惜一切代價」言論，暗示干預行動並非一次性事件。投資者目前正密切關注即將公布的美國非農就業報告與通膨數據，這些數據將成為決定日元是否會面臨新一輪拋售壓力的關鍵催化劑。
paras_en: The yen has given back nearly half of its gain since the joint intervention by Japan and the US, sparking heated discussions about whether the authorities will launch a second round of intervention.

As of Friday afternoon, the yen traded at around 158.40, far below the strong high of 155.23 set on Monday. Just last week, the yen briefly approached a 40-year low of 164, prompting Japan and the US to take their first joint action to buy yen since 1998.

The recent reversal of the yen's rate highlights the limitations of relying solely on intervention to reverse the yen's long-term depreciation trend. The significant interest rate differential between the US and Japan, Japan's heavy debt burden, and geopolitical uncertainty all continue to put pressure on the yen. With the Middle East situation driving up oil prices, market optimism about easing tensions has weakened, supporting the dollar's two-week high on Thursday.
Market analysts point out that with the yen rate again approaching the key integer threshold of 160, the possibility of the authorities intervening again is extremely high.

Australian Federal Bank strategist Carol Kong warns that if the yen breaks below the 160 threshold without intervention, it will encourage traders to rebuild yen short positions, which is exactly what policymakers are trying to avoid. In fact, Japan has intervened in the currency market three times during the spring golden period, showing its determination to maximize psychological impact.

However, the long-term effectiveness of intervention still depends on the coordination of monetary policy. OCBC Bank strategist Moh Siong Sim believes that intervention will only have a real impact if it is accompanied by the Bank of Japan's more aggressive interest rate hikes or the Fed's shift to a more accommodative policy. Currently, the overnight index swap shows that the Bank of Japan has a 60% chance of raising interest rates before September.
Japan's top foreign exchange official, Mitsuru Miyazawa, said that the authorities will coordinate the exchange rate trend with monetary policy to respond together.

Looking ahead, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's 'no matter what' comments suggest that intervention is not a one-time event. Investors are closely watching the upcoming US non-farm payroll and inflation data, which will be key catalysts for determining whether the yen will face a new round of selling pressure.

items.title: 先斬後奏！ FT：美賣歐元推高日元   歐洲央行直到交易執行才收到華府通知
items.title_en: FT: US Sells Euro to Boost Yen, ECB Only Notified After Fact
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國上週五 (7 月 31 日) 為提振日元而賣出歐元的操作，令歐洲央行 (ECB) 措手不及，因華府在這筆歷史性匯市干預執行完畢後，才通知法蘭克福方面。
《金融時報》今 (7) 日引述多位消息人士報導，ECB 是在上週五交易成交後，才得知美國出售歐元、買入日元的動向，ECB 總裁拉加德與美國財長貝森特也在隔天就此次干預通話。
報導指出，這種「先斬後奏」凸顯出近 30 年來美日首度聯手護匯的不尋常。按戰後西方貨幣當局慣例，美國若介入匯市通常動用美元，而非動用歐元。
部分 ECB 高層認為，華府改用歐元交易，是對西方央行長期合作慣例的「空前違背」。
一名了解歐洲決策層討論的人士形容，紐約聯準銀行代表美國財政部執行的賣歐元行動「非常引人注目」且「令人遺憾」，並稱「這種事從未發生過」，二戰後西方靠互信與事前磋商維繫的匯市協調傳統，可能正受威脅。
美國財政部發言人表示，透過「匯率穩定基金」(ESF) 配置儲備資產的決定由華府自作主張，不與外國當局協調。「ESF 資產配置由財政部依市場流動性、估值等評估定奪」，上週透過 ESF 在內部重配準備資產屬職權範圍。
一名白宮官員更說：「我們尊重與國際同僚私下討論的機密性，不像 ECB。」
華府選擇賣歐元而非賣美元，主因是怕拋美元被解讀為弱勢美元信號、打臉貝森特「強勢美元政策」。
分析師也揣測，美國陪日本出手，是想避免後者在美債殖利率逼近 19 年高點時賣債換美元。
日本在 7 月最後兩天估計耗資約 13.8 兆日元 (870 億美元)，已超過 4-5 月創下的 11.73 兆日元舊紀錄。
美日上週五聯手把美元兌日元從近 164(1986 年以來低點) 拉回 157，其後略貶至 158。
市場仍憂心日本央行 (BOJ) 升息太慢，BOJ 總裁植田和男上月會議按兵不動，但坦言「通膨上行風險需更關注」，市場看好下月升息機率約 44%。
美國這次「用歐元救日元」的非常規操作，短期震懾套利空頭，卻也讓西方貨幣協調的信任底線露出一道裂痕。
paras_en: A US operation to boost the yen by selling euros last Friday (July 31) caught the European Central Bank (ECB) off guard, as Washington only notified Frankfurt after the historic intervention.

The Financial Times reported on July 7 that the ECB only learned of the US sale of euros and purchase of yen after the trade was completed on Friday, with ECB President Christine Lagarde and US Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin speaking about the intervention the following day.
The 'shoot first, tell later' approach highlights the unusual nature of the US-Japan alliance to defend their currencies, which has not happened in nearly 30 years.
Some ECB officials view the US decision to use euros in the intervention as a 'historic breach' of the long-standing cooperation between Western central banks.

A person familiar with the European decision-making process described the New York Federal Reserve's sale of euros as 'highly unusual' and 'regrettable', saying 'this has never happened before', and that the post-war tradition of Western currency coordination based on trust and prior consultation may be under threat.

A US Treasury spokesperson said that the decision to use the Exchange Stabilization Fund (ESF) to allocate reserve assets was made by Washington without coordination with foreign authorities, stating that 'ESF asset allocation is determined by the Treasury Department based on market liquidity, valuation, and other assessments'.
A White House official added that 'we respect the confidentiality of private discussions with international colleagues, unlike the ECB'.
The US chose to sell euros instead of dollars to avoid being seen as a sign of a weak dollar, which would undermine Mnuchin's 'strong dollar policy'.
Analysts speculate that the US joined Japan to avoid the latter selling bonds and buying dollars when US bond yields approached a 19-year high.
Japan is estimated to have spent around ¥13.8 trillion (approximately $870 billion) in the last two days of July, exceeding the previous record of ¥11.73 trillion set in April-May.
The US and Japan jointly pushed the dollar-yen exchange rate from near 164 (a 1986 low) back to 157 on Friday, and it later fell to 158.

Markets remain concerned that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) may be raising interest rates too slowly, with BOJ Governor Haruhiko Kuroda saying in a recent meeting that 'the risk of inflation rising is more pressing', and market expectations for a rate hike in August are around 44%.
The US's unconventional use of euros to rescue the yen has temporarily shaken out short sellers, but has also exposed a crack in the trust between Western currency coordinators.

items.title: 今年干預次數額度疑似用完！日本黃金週期間三度出手護日元 Q2砸11.74兆創單季新高
items.title_en: Intervention Quota Seems Exhausted! Japan Acts Three Times During Golden Week to Support Yen, Q2 Intervention Hits 11.74 Trillion Yen, a New Quarterly Record
paras: 日本財務省今 (7) 日公佈今年第二季每日干預明細，證實在 4 月 30 日、5 月 4 日、5 月 6 日三度買入日元，金額分別為 6.28 兆、0.78 兆、4.68 兆日元，合計 11.74 兆日元(約 785 億美元)，創日本歷次匯市防衛單季最高規模。
根據日本財務省數據，今年第二季較上月底美日聯手多出一輪單邊操作，且確認除上述三天外，黃金週期間曾有五次盤中急貶，當局未做其他平滑干預。出手干預前，日元兌美元匯率跌破 160，三輪出手後匯價拉回 155 附近。
日本財務省數據加上週五 (7 月 31 日) 與華府協同買進日元，市場推算日本在 IMF 規則下的 2026 會計年度干預額度已觸頂，與華府聯手觸發「六個月冷卻期」重置機制。理論上，日本直到 2027 年初前，不能再次單邊進場。
對日元套利交易者，干預額度疑似用罄是明確綠燈，空頭不必再防「隨時有 8 兆級砸盤」，倉位回補意願上升。
但部分投資人存疑，川普時代「基於規則的干預框架」實際約束力弱化，若日元再破 165，華府是否默許東京破例或改以口頭 + 美債端配合，仍留灰色地帶。
短期看，匯市波動率料將回落，但 2027 前「無干預承諾」本身，也可能成為下一輪空頭加槓桿的催化。
paras_en: Japan's Ministry of Finance today (the 7th) released the daily intervention details for the second quarter of this year, confirming three yen purchases on April 30, May 4, and May 6, amounting to 6.28 trillion, 0.78 trillion, and 4.68 trillion yen respectively, for a total of 11.74 trillion yen (about $78.5 billion), the largest single‑quarter foreign‑exchange market defence operation in Japan's history.

According to Ministry data, the second quarter saw one more unilateral operation compared with the end of last month’s US‑Japan joint effort, and besides the three days above, there were five intraday sharp depreciations during Golden Week that the authorities did not smooth with additional intervention. Before the interventions, the yen‑dollar rate had fallen below 160, and after the three rounds it rebounded to around 155.

Combined with the coordinated yen purchase with Washington on Friday (July 31), market participants estimate that Japan’s intervention quota for the 2026 fiscal year under IMF rules has been reached, triggering a “six‑month cooling‑off” reset mechanism with the U.S. In theory, Japan cannot make another unilateral entry until early 2027.

For yen arbitrage traders, the apparent depletion of the intervention quota is a clear green light; short sellers no longer need to guard against a sudden 8‑trillion‑yen dump, and their willingness to cover positions is increasing.

However, some investors remain skeptical, noting that the rule‑based intervention framework from the Trump era had weakened in enforceability; if the yen were to slip past 165, it is unclear whether Washington would tacitly allow Tokyo an exception or resort to verbal coordination plus U.S. Treasury actions, leaving a gray area.
In the short term, FX volatility is expected to ease, but the lack of an “intervention commitment” through 2027 could itself become a catalyst for the next wave of short‑selling leverage.

隨著日本財務數據顯示，得益於美國與日本聯合干預後日圓走強及海外債券收益率維持高位提振需求，日本投資人三周來首度淨買入海外債券，限制日圓上漲，並據人力資源機構 Challenger Gray & Christmas 報告，美國 7 月雇主計畫裁員數降至 2024 年 7 月以來最低 33,429 人，而且美國勞工部公布上周初請失業金人數為 19.9 萬人低於預期及第二季勞動生產率以年化 1.4% 的速度增長遠高於預估值，激勵美元兌日圓漲至 158.55 高點。今日市場聚焦美國就業報告，預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於 158.00-20，阻力於 159.00-20。
◆EUR/USD
昨日澳洲數據顯示，黃金和鐵礦石出口強勁反彈，且進口經歷強勁增長後趨平穩，6 月商品貿易收支意外轉為 19 億澳幣順差，並隨著市場基本排除澳洲央行 (RBA) 下周會議加息的可能性，但料措辭偏鷹，亦堅信紐西蘭央行 (RBNZ) 在 9 月會議升息，而且荷姆茲海峽航運達成協議的希望支撐澳幣和紐元等風險貨幣，帶動歐元兌美元觸及 1.1559 高點。
隨後德國公布經季節性及日曆調整後 6 月工業訂單較前月大增 3.1%，經季節調整製造業產出價格亦升 9.9%，但歐元區 6 月零售銷售較前月跌 0.3% 及較去年同期增長 0.7% 皆遜於預期，而且伊朗議會審議禁止美國和以色列船隻進入荷姆茲海峽法案草案，打擊歐元兌美元至 1.1514 低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於 1.1520-40，支撐於 1.1440-60。
◆GBP/USD

週四標準普爾 (S&P) 全球調查英國 7 月建築業採購經理人指數 (PMI) 升至 44.7 及商業建築活動指數創四個月新高 46.8，建築商信心升至伊朗戰爭前以來最高，而且全球金融市場對伊朗和阿曼達成協議的期望升溫，提振英鎊兌美元至 1.3479 高點。隨著市場對英國央行 (BOE) 升息的預期恐過於激進，而且美國就業數據前的避險操作支撐美元，打壓英鎊兌美元至 1.3445 低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於 1.3450-70，支撐於 1.3360-80。

Today's market focus is on the US employment report, with support at 158.00-20 and resistance at 159.00-20.
